Invite people · optional
  Each person gets their own sign-in and works in the same bots and chats as everyone; you choose who is an admin.
<QR>
  1. Invite someone
     The invite is a link and a code, for one person, good for 7 days. Send it to them yourself. They join at the workspace's address, so it needs one their computer reaches: see Where the workspace listens.
     On the workspace:
       fleetd invite --name <name>
       --role admin for another admin.
<QR>
  In the app: Settings › Workspace › People.
–  Invite people optional · fleetd init --step people

Run fleetd init --step people again when you've done it; it keeps what's done.
